title: LTFRB focused on riders' welfare as it fines MC taxi platform for going beyond cap
summary: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board said it is "crafting measures" to help riders after it penalized a motorcycle riding platform for taking on more riders than it was allowed to.
